en: A sepia-toned panoramic photograph of a city with dense neoclassical-style buildings and a prominent conical hill in the background. The card features the printed text 'Athènes, et le Méditerranée. La Nouvelle Athènes.' in French in the lower left corner, and a website watermark www.elia.org.gr across the bottom right. The overall style and print quality suggest an early 20th-century period.
